quest.title: Friends of Fire and Water
quest.description: You and Paimon discover a suspicious campsite somewhere within Flower-Feather Clan territory. There, you unexpectedly rescue a Blubberbeast. It seems to make a good friend for your Saurian companion...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We said we were going to cook, but what exactly should we make?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... We used to feed fish to the Blubberbeast Berrypuff, didn't we? In that case, a fish dish should do just fine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #If we want the Blubberbeast and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to eat well... Natlan's special Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce might be a pretty good choice.

choices.text: That's practically a specialty of mine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's get started then. Paimon will give you some pointers while you're at it!

choices.text: Make deeper cuts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! The deeper the cuts, the deeper the flavor seeps in!

choices.text: A little extra salt, a little extra happiness!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Mmm, that sure tastes rich. {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and the Blubberbeast are going to love it!

choices.text: Mint sauce. The more, the merrier.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, that refreshing, cool taste is going to be awesome!

choices.text: Chili peppers are indispensable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just the right amount of spiciness — enough to whet the appetite!

choices.text: Flame-grilled over scorching heat — crispy on the outside, tender on the inside!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heehee, that sounds so delicious, Paimon's drooling already.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #After a splendid culinary process, the special fish you grilled for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and the Blubberbeast is ready...

choices.text: Slow roasted — tender and juicy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wow, amazing! {NICKNAME}'s secret art grilled fish... Maybe someday it'll become one of your specialties and you'll be able to cook it for our other friends!

choices.text: Animals from Fontaine might be allergic to spicy food...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it'd feel like something is missing if there's no chili at all, so why not add just a little?

choices.text: Flame-grilled over scorching heat — crispy on the outside, tender on the inside!
Slow roasted — tender and juicy!
Will an aquatic animal like the Blubberbeast be afraid of mint?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not how that works. A Blubberbeast is going to find the surface dry and hot, so adding a little mint sauce ought to help it cool down, right?

choices.text: Chili peppers are indispensable.
Animals from Fontaine might be allergic to spicy food...
The flavor's great as-is. No need for any salt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. We've still got other seasonings, so we don't have to go so heavy on the salt.

choices.text: Mint sauce. The more, the merrier.
Will an aquatic animal like the Blubberbeast be afraid of mint?
Make shallower cuts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not bad. It should keep the flavor light while maintaining the original fishiness — which the Blubberbeast is sure to love.

choices.text: A little extra salt, a little extra happiness!
The flavor's great as-is. No need for any salt.
Can't say I've perfected it, but no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure enough, there are still some Saurians locked up here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who'd have thought they'd persist in their wicked ways and keep hurting Saurians, even after we destroyed their base...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Had we known, we could've chased them down and wiped them all out.

choices.text: Well, they're all done for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True. Now let's save 'em, quick!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: Yes, I should've been cold and cruel back then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon can hardly imagine you being like that, {NICKNAME}... Anyway, let's help 'em first!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why are there Saurians in the cages here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Something's not right here... Wait. Could they all have been captured by those people?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have we busted some kinda Saurian trafficking ring without even realizing it?

choices.text: Wonderful! Villains vanquished, by the by!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Now let's get all these Saurians outta here!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: Doesn't matter. We took those villains out either way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, it matters a lot — that the kidnapped Saurians can now regain their freedom, that is. Let's help them, pronto!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, there's a... Blubberbeast in here? How in the world—? Guess bad guys really will sell anything...

dialogues.speaker: Victimized Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: Awrr... Bluboo!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rroo... Mrrooh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? You're kinda interested in the Blubberbeast, aren't you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} listens intently to the cries of the Blubberbeast and, seemingly understanding something, lifts the creature by the tail to take it over to the shallows, where they play together.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

choices.text: The Blubberbeast seems chuffed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure does! Maybe they can become friends?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But that Blubberbeast doesn't seem to have the slightest bit of strength, and its two... Err, paws...? Either way, they don't seem able to flap around much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There wasn't even a plate of food around... Perhaps they've been locked up so long that they're starving.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #If that's so, let's make something for the Blubberbeast and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to eat!

choices.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} seems pretty happy, too.

talks.objective: Prepare food for your animal friends
Deliver food to your animal friends
Deliver food to your animal friends

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here comes something yummy! Don't just play around — you have to replenish your energy, too.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: A... Aooouhh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looks like they're having a great time. Will you choke if you eat upside down like that, though...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stay safe. Don't be like that Blubberbeast.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what's with that patronizing tone? Paimon's no Blubberbeast. She's not gonna be so silly as to eat like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Try it yourself and you'll see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Paimon's not gonna eat like that — she isn't a Blubberbeast anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Blubberbeast seems to have recovered enough strength for it to flap over and tumble into the sea...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Mmm... Aourgh!

dialogues.speaker: Now-Healthy Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: Aohh! Woo... Arr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's gone...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's just how things are. I mean, it's not indigenous to Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrooh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't be sad, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. You had so much fun just now, and you're already friends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, Paimon's got a feeling that this isn't the last we've seen of that Blubberbeast!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We said we were going to cook, but what exactly should we make?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Blubberbeasts live in the water, so it must eat fish, right? Let's do a fish dish, then.

dialogues.text: Aouhhh...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Arawr?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Awwrr...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: Aouh?

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: Aouh...

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: Auh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't understand their conversation at all, but it seems they've reached an understanding...?

choices.text: It's fine if you don't get it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Makes sense. Even though the Blubberbeast doesn't have much strength, it feels like they're really happy — and Paimon feels happy for 'em, too!

choices.text: As long as the emotion's there, that's all that matters.
